request: チャッピーに画面みてもらって
delivery: Native Firefox attachment/send UI; app read_thread independently confirms posted user message with two image attachments and completed assistant reply. Assistant prose read from visible Firefox accessibility tree.

target.kind: Explicit mature diagnostics on local production; not normal acquisition or child observation

replySummary: 大型建築の存在感は増したが、育てた場所に入り、遊びたいと感じる表現は未達という評価。
特に回廊全景は海の余白が強く、島・所有物・ぽこもこを識別しづらい。
共有屋根は家との支え、玄関、庭への入口と下の居場所が読めず、別の大きな建物を置いたように見える可能性。
大木は目立つが登り口・歩ける床の連続・出口が読めない。
次に直す一つとして、島/場所/人物を見渡せて、入口を発見できる標準画角を提案。
reviewerProposals: 全景で島と地区、場所の選択で入口と床、人物の操作でぽこもこへ自然に焦点を移す。
支え・入口・実床と元の家の見た目を一致させる。
拡張など操作UIが育った場所より目立たないよう、使用中の主従を見直す。
codexAssessment: These are image-based design recommendations; not adopted specification or proof of child comprehension.
The small-island assessment is particularly clear for the gallery overview; do not treat both images as the same camera framing.
The reply inserted unrelated Tiny Isle/Fortnite visual examples despite the request for no references. Those images are not the app evidence and are not adopted benchmarks.
P04 actual-use validation is reported prior technical evidence, not independently reproduced by Chappy.
P02 use remains unresolved; the images establish neither camera-only causation nor a broken walking graph.
